purpose: Teach: 加筆/手直し/終点/公示/客室/税別/免税/効能

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、企画書に加筆を入れて再提出しろ
lines.en: Add to the proposal and resubmit it.
lines.style: Direct command, clipped tempo. No softening. Eyes forward. Expectation of compliance is assumed, not negotiated.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サンプル品の手直しを工場に依頼しました
lines.en: Understood. I've already requested the factory to refine the samples.
lines.style: Steady, competent confirmation. Slight lift on 'already' — showing he's ahead of the curve. Respectful but not obsequious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の新事業、終点を見据えて計画しろ
lines.en: Plan the new business with the end goal in mind from the start.
lines.style: Measured instruction. Deliberate pacing on 'end goal' — he's laying out the framework. Strategic rather than urgent.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の発売を公示する手続きを進めます
lines.en: Understood. I'll move forward with the public notice procedures for the new product launch.
lines.style: Assured, efficient report. Smooth handoff tone — demonstrating he understands the path and has momentum.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お客様用客室の整備を急げ
lines.en: Accelerate the preparation of the customer guest rooms.
lines.style: Sharp, compressed. Stress on 'accelerate' — this has priority. No hedging. Expectant silence after.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。価格は税別表記でカタログに記載します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure the prices are listed in the catalog as tax-excluded.
lines.style: Calm execution. Matter-of-fact detail work. Shows he's already thinking through the implications and logistics.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海外向け店舗で免税対応を整えろ
lines.en: Set up tax-free procedures for the overseas stores.
lines.style: Crisper tempo. International scope widens the frame. Still command-mode but slightly more expansive than domestic directives.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の効能を実証データで示します
lines.en: Understood. I'll demonstrate the new product's effectiveness with performance data.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Quiet confidence on 'performance data' — he's bringing proof, not just promise. Small nod of finality.
